skin_switching.applied: Now wearing %s's skin. Use /skin reset to restore your own.
skin_switching.sync.sent: Saved %s's skin and notified all players. Clients are downloading it.
skin_switching.reset: Restored your original skin and cancelled pending changes.
skin_switching.status.client: Client only · Current skin: %s. Change: /skin switching name; restore: /skin reset
skin_switching.status.sync: Multiplayer sync · Selected skin: %s. Change: /skin switching name; restore: /skin reset
skin_switching.error.invalid_name: Enter a Minecraft Java username: 1–16 letters, numbers or underscores.
skin_switching.error.not_found: No Minecraft Java account found. Check the name; your current skin is unchanged.
skin_switching.error.no_skin: This account has no available custom skin. Your current skin is unchanged.
skin_switching.error.network: Cannot reach Mojang. Check your connection and try later; the displayed skin is unchanged.
skin_switching.error.rate_limit: Mojang has temporarily rate-limited requests. Please try later.
skin_switching.error.cooldown: Wait 5 seconds between lookups. Reset is always available.
skin_switching.error.busy: The skin download queue is full. Please try later.
skin_switching.error.invalid_profile: Invalid or incomplete skin profile. The displayed skin is unchanged.
skin_switching.error.signature: Mojang skin signature verification failed. The displayed skin is unchanged.
skin_switching.error.texture: Could not download or read the skin image. The displayed skin is unchanged. Retry the switch command.
skin_switching.error.storage: Cannot read or save skin selections. Check logs, the saved file and directory permissions.
